newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Bahrain agrees to host U.S. military planes.
newsitem.headline: Bahrain agrees to host U.S. military planes.

text.p: Bahrain said on Sunday it had agreed to host U.S. military planes but it was not immediately clear if the move was linked to the Iraq crisis.
The state Gulf News Agency quoted an official as saying that the Gulf Arab country had "agreed to host a number of U.S. military planes on its territory".
The agency said the move came in the framework of a defence cooperation pact between the two countries. It gave no further details.
Bahrain is already home to the administrative headquarters the U.S. Fifth Fleet patrolling the Gulf to help enforce a no-fly zone over southern Iraq.
